description: Java abstract class defining constants and utility methods for request-response API handling, including methods to create AMQP reply and error messages.

classes.name: RequestResponseApiConstants
classes.description: Defines constants and static utility methods for request-response messaging in AMQP, including message creation for replies and errors.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Creates an AMQP message as a reply to a service invocation, setting properties like correlation ID, address, and application properties based on response data.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Creates an AMQP message conveying an error, setting status and optional error description payload.
